integrity: Exact finite-field witnesses, a complete rank/dependence case proof, standard-library verifier and execution output included; no independent review claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only rank-three four-column linear encodings of a (1,2) file partition under uniform noiseless sampling. The finite checks cover selected prime fields and the infinite-field assertion uses an explicit proof; an unindexed earlier equivalent result cannot be ruled out.
title: Four-point Pareto frontier for single-redundancy, three-dimensional file retrieval
